title: [Main] Fix #656831: Use location state for ISD purchase credit memo posting
summary: Interstate ISD purchase credit memo posting now correctly uses the location's state instead of the vendor's state when retrieving GST posting setup and G/L accounts.
key_points: Fixed GST posting setup lookup to filter by location state rather than vendor state
Updated detailed GST ledger G/L account lookup to use location state code
Resolves posting failures when vendor state differs from purchase line location state
Incremented use case version from 2 to 3 and updated GST configuration registry
quote: Updated both lookups to use Location.State Code, filtered by Purchase Line.Location Code.
